scene_description: A white BART bus is positioned on a gravel embankment, showing significant structural damage and deformation on its side and front. The front of the bus is pressed against a large, black cylindrical train car. Debris is scattered across the gravel surface, and a person wearing a high-visibility yellow vest is visible inside the bus. Bare trees and a blue sky with white clouds are in the background.<turn|>
editing_instruction: Add a group of emergency first responders in high-visibility gear and helmets positioned around the bus and train car. Place a heavy-duty tow truck and a fire engine with flashing emergency lights nearby on the gravel embankment. Add a mobile command center vehicle and a portable lighting tower. Place orange traffic cones and yellow caution tape around the perimeter of the crash site. Add a group of rescue workers using hydraulic rescue tools (Jaws of Life) near the damaged front of the bus. Include a medical triage tent and a portable generator in the background. Ensure all vehicles and personnel are scaled realistically to the bus and train car, matching the natural daylight and
